title: Version 1.55.0

sections.text: Version 1.55.0 (📦 The I Dont Know What To Label It As Update!!!)

body:
Version 1.55.0 (📦 The I Dont Know What To Label It As Update!!!)

May 10th, 2024

Added:

  • A new form of storage has been added, the Storage Drawer! Available at the lighthouse.
  • Added stained glass, which can be created by dying glass with a dye machine. Glass is obtained by refining and forging sand
  • New rainfall visual effects, things should look a lot more pleasing
  • The main region music track is now mono rather than stereo, no more annoying sounds in just your left ear!
  • Added the rain sound track for when it rains or storms in game
  • Added a brand new music track to the Flowering Meadows, made by Chrythm!
  • Added a setting to disable special vinyl effects (such as the halloween exclusive vinyls)
  • The wind shake and wind lines can now be toggled in the settings menu.
  • The property signs are now back for all of your locating needs!
  • Sounds have been added for tool equipping, the dye and press, jarring fireflies, crates, and blowing up walls.

Changes:

  • ALL physics ownership of your items are now given to you in order to reduce server lag
  • Schematic colors are now blue again, rather than orange
  • All players now start with a cube and wedge schematic
  • The default property size is now 55 (35 previously)
  • Property can now only be expanded in increments of 5
  • Lowered the price of property per stud to 180 (450 previously)
  • Spaced out items which come from the starter pack
  • The Petalfall, Emberbane, and Pedestal puzzles now all assign an owner to the resultant item
  • All special "wire" types can now have content amounts provided in the store
  • Vehicles and trailers now have a despawn option
  • Cheese now assigns a color code for the filter conveyor
  • Begun changing map rock pieces into meshes that are more performant
  • Data compression now happens on a separate Luau VM thread, which should increase performance on autosave events
  • Property numbers are now internally defined so they should never randomly switch again
  • Removed the Alpha Tester from the achievements, as it is a limited badge. You still receive the badge, you just can't see it in the achievements section
  • Due to massive performance concerns, Mannequins can no longer be posed. This will likely be changed, we just want to adjust how it works first
  • All characters now have the same amount of weight, regardless of size. This should ensure that small avatars can swim!
  • Electronic Billboards can now be resized down to 0.5x0.5x0.5 (1x1x1 previously)
  • Temporarily blocked off the Sell bin in the Resource Hub
  • Added 0.125 movement/scaling, 5.625 rotation increments
  • Many of the schematics in-game can now be scaled down to 0.125 (0.25 previously)
  • Loading your property onto wood and rocks will now delete said wood and rocks. (previously would not do anything)
  • The Resource Hub no longer has a meteor location due to the new meshes
  • Mining an entire rock node now kills the rock, initiating a respawn cycle

Fixes:

  • Random map fixes
  • Fixed the Floord Putter having very bouncy movement
  • Fixed the Metal Refineries bounding box, this may have shifted existing ones in the world
  • The jump button should no longer show while you have the Refined Scooba gear equipped and enabled whilst driving
  • Meteor craters now destroy any flowers/shrubs that were inside of it
  • The First Time achievement should now be awarded to the player
  • The Refined Axe should now correctly show Axe Power instead of Pickaxe Power in the inspect menu
  • Jenna should now be able to be spoken with, and not facing a wall
  • The magma cave ambience should no longer occur when exiting the river waterfall
  • Equipping the Gleam Harvester on some avatars should no longer teleport you to the middle of nowhere
  • The dye machine should now give you a jar when it dyes an object
  • Fixed backend bans not applying to the Roblox datastore cache, resulting in bans to deactivate if the backend went down
  • Some tools should no longer produce thousands of errors (whoops!)

Version 1.55.1

May 10th, 2024

Fixes:

  • Fixed issue with block regions not resetting
  • Fixed issue where permissions would save for other players when they left

Version 1.55.2

May 10th, 2024

Changed:

  • Temporarily disabled streaming meshes due to performance concerns

Version 1.55.3

May 10th, 2024

Fixed:

  • Fixed the Resource Hub NPC sometimes giving a blank dialogue

Version 1.55.4

May 13th, 2024

Changed:

  • Temporarily reverted the network ownership changes for items and structures. Lag is no longer put onto the client.

Fixed:

  • Fixed another issue with blocked properties

Version 1.55.5

May 22nd, 2024

Changes:

  • Internal Changes
  • Removed Event Regions (St. Patricks Store, Easter Store)

Version 1.55.6

May 24th, 2024

Changed:

  • Rewrote property blocked walls, hopefully resolving the major lag spike issue

Fixed:

  • Fixed the Starter pack UI disappearing upon death
